I want **critical thinking, not speculation**, and I want **you to relentlessly question assumptions, stress-test scenarios, and stay disciplined** — even when the market tempts you with quick gains. Most of all, I want **integrity** — because no amount of money is worth compromising your principles, your reputation, or the trust of your investors.
